content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> *   The "Hanoi Bia Hoi Junction Guided Crawl" is a 2-hour, low-physical-demand experience focusing on Vietnamese street drinking culture at Ta Hien street in Hanoi's Old Quarter. Participants consume daily-brewed, preservative-free Bia Hoi beer and snacks like grilled fermented pork and roasted peanuts.
> *   Asia Golf Specialists (AGS) offers this year-round experience with advance booking required, providing priority reservations, skip-the-line access, and luxury SUV transfers. The dress code is smart casual, with some venues potentially requiring closed-toe shoes.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Dive into the absolute epicenter of Vietnamese street drinking culture at the infamous Bia Hoi corner. It is chaotic, cheap, authentic, and an absolute right of passage.

## The Operator & Origin Story
Bia Hoi (fresh beer) is brewed daily without preservatives and delivered in kegs on motorbikes. It is consumed rapidly sitting on legendary tiny plastic stools on the pavement.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
Navigate the intense motorbike traffic of the Old Quarter. Arrive at Ta Hien street and secure a pavement table. Your guide will order pitchers of the incredibly light beer alongside staple drinking snacks: grilled fermented pork and roasted peanuts.

## Experience Data
| Metric | Details |
|---|---|
| **Vibe / Atmosphere** | Chaotic, Authentic, Sociable |
| **Duration** | 2 Hours |
| **Physical Demand** | Low |
| **Best Paired With** | A casual evening after exploring the Old Quarter. |

## From the Private Clubhouses of Van Tri & Legend Hill to Hanoi’s Legendary Beer Corner
After playing 18 holes at Hanoi’s ultra-exclusive [Van Tri Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/van-tri-golf-club/), Jack Nicklaus’s twin-green [Legend Hill Country Club](/courses/vietnam/legend-hill/), or the championship lakes of [Kings Island Golf Resort](/courses/vietnam/kings-island/) and [Sky Lake Resort & Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/sky-lake/), there is no greater cultural contrast than trading leather clubhouse armchairs for the electric pavement atmosphere of **Tạ Hiện & Lương Ngọc Quyến ("Bia Hơi Junction")** in Hanoi’s Old Quarter. Located less than 8 minutes from [Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi](/accommodations/vietnam/sofitel-metropole-hanoi/), [Capella Hanoi](/accommodations/vietnam/capella-hanoi/), and [The Oriental Jade Hotel](/accommodations/vietnam/the-oriental-jade/), this two-hour guided evening crawl is a rite of passage for every Australian golf group on our [Hanoi & Halong Bay](/tours/the-emperors-fairways/) tour.

## Fresh-Keg Vetting,Elevated Seating & Late-Night Transitions
* **Verified Daily-Keg *Bia Hơi Hà Nội* Outlets:** True *Bia Hơi* is a crisp, unpasteurized 3.5% ABV draft lager brewed each morning at the Habeco brewery on Hoang Hoa Tham Street and delivered in steel kegs to be finished the same night. Rather than sitting at tourist-trap bars serving bottled beer, your Hanoi host takes your group to authentic high-turnover corner taps where the kegs were tapped hours earlier—and where second-floor balcony tables are available if your group prefers proper chairs over low plastic stools.
* **Classic Northern Beer Snacks (*Mồi Nhậu*):** Pair ice-cold ridged glass mugs of fresh draft with crispy fermented pork rolls (*Nem Chua Nướng*), lemongrass-steamed clams, dried squid charred over alcohol flames, and salted boiled peanuts.
* **Five-Star Speakeasy Cap-Off:** After soaking up 90 minutes of Old Quarter buzz, walk or transfer five minutes back to Hoan Kiem for a vintage single malt at the Bamboo Bar inside [Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi](/accommodations/vietnam/sofitel-metropole-hanoi/) or the Diva’s Lounge at [Capella Hanoi](/accommodations/vietnam/capella-hanoi/).

## Integrating Bia Hoi Junction Into Your Hanoi & Halong Bay Golf Schedule
On our [Hanoi & Halong Bay](/tours/the-emperors-fairways/) golf journey, we schedule this 6:30 PM Old Quarter draft-beer crawl after your opening championship round at [Kings Island Golf Resort](/courses/vietnam/kings-island/), [Sky Lake Resort & Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/sky-lake/), or [Legend Hill Country Club](/courses/vietnam/legend-hill/). Because the crawl concludes by 8:30 PM—just minutes from [Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi](/accommodations/vietnam/sofitel-metropole-hanoi/), [Capella Hanoi](/accommodations/vietnam/capella-hanoi/), and [The Oriental Jade Hotel](/accommodations/vietnam/the-oriental-jade/)—your fourball gets a full night’s rest before teeing off at [Van Tri Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/van-tri-golf-club/) or departing for [FLC Halong Bay Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/flc-ha-long-bay/).

faqs.q: Where is Hanoi's Bia Hoi Junction located relative to Sofitel Legend Metropole and Capella Hanoi?
faqs.a: Bia Hoi Junction sits at the intersection of Ta Hien and Luong Ngoc Quyen streets in the heart of Hanoi's Old Quarter—just 5 to 8 minutes by private SUV from Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi, Capella Hanoi, and The Oriental Jade Hotel.

faqs.q: Do we have to sit on tiny plastic stools during the Hanoi Bia Hoi crawl?
faqs.a: Trying a glass on the iconic low pavement stools is part of the fun, but your Asia Golf Specialists host also reserves upstairs balcony tables with full-sized chairs overlooking Ta Hien Street for golf groups who want extra comfort after 18 holes at Kings Island or Sky Lake.

faqs.q: What is Bia Hoi, and why is it only found fresh in Northern Vietnam?
faqs.a: Bia Hoi is a light, preservative-free draft lager brewed daily in Hanoi and delivered in unpasteurized kegs that must be consumed within 24 hours, giving it a uniquely crisp, refreshing finish after a warm day on the fairways.
